evidence.quote: The following tuition fees apply for applicants from: non-EU countries 1,000 EUR
Students from non-EEA countries who enrol in this programme must pay tuition each semester.

notes: Tuition: 1,000 EUR is charged per semester (not per year) to international students from non-EEA countries; the amountMinor 100000 therefore uses period 'semester'. The DAAD page gives a general application period for 'all countries'; the university page gives a dated winter-semester window (2 May 2027 to 15 July 2027) for the winter semester. The pages mention that all required documents must be sent by post but do not give a document list for this bachelor programme. No document list and no subject or prior-study-year requirement could be quoted for this programme, so those facts are omitted. The application-channel quote only confirms international applicants apply to the programme; the pages do not name uni-assist or a VPD for this programme, so de-university-direct is a cautious default.

note.en: Admission is subject to a numerus clausus: selection is based on the final average grade of your university entrance qualification (e.g. school-leaving certificate).
